identity.toponym: Romkemet (the Nile-province of the Eagle; lit. 'Rome of the Black Land')

flavor.phonemic_palette: near_eastern (egyptian: the per/nesut/heqa register, the itru/Nile temple-cities, -aa/-et theophoric stems, dj/tj/kh phonology, VSO; the sun-disc cult and the funerary akhu) / classical (latinate: the civic/legal/military/road register - via, legio, castra, forum, colonia, the imperial eagle and the standing legions over the grain-province)

religion_hooks.alignment_lens: Resolved per the culture's chosen alignment (setting-lore): Lawful venerates the Lawful powers and names the Chaotic as demons; Chaotic the reverse; Neutral honors ancestral and local powers, invoking the great powers situationally.

flavor_text.one_line: Romkem — proselytizing sacerdotal hierocracy of the synthesis; law, piety, tradition.
flavor_text.one_paragraph: The Romkem are a measured sacerdotal hierocracy people, a first-order synthesis of Kemetra and Vallica [Peer Synthesis / Theocratic]. They prize law, piety, tradition, lean toward the religious sphere, and field heavy_infantry, chariots, archers. Outsiders are met as proselytizing; their patrons touch law.
